title: Specification Error Detector
description: The learner critiques a ten-clause draft specification for a 500°F dryer exhaust fan, marking each clause acceptable or defective with one of seven reasons; one submission reveals every clause's verdict and reason, scores n of 10, and offers the corrected specification.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: specification review
fan specification
airstream conditions
arrangement selection
spark-resistant construction
cold start motor sizing
octave band sound data
flex connectors
rights: Copyright 2026 Twin City Fan. All rights reserved.

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Reviewing a fan specification for completeness and consistency
learningObjectives: The learner will critique a ten-clause draft fan specification by flagging each clause as acceptable or defective and choosing the reason for each defect, with at least 9 of 10 clauses judged correctly.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); results announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; every clause has a labelled native drop-down; Tab and arrow keys operate everything; focus moves to Try again after submission.

controls.label: Clause 1 ... 10 judgment
controls.purpose: Mark the clause Acceptable or Defective with reason (a) to (g)

controls.label: Submit review
controls.purpose: Submit all ten marks (the first submission is recorded)

controls.label: Try again
controls.purpose: Clear the marks, keep the order and the recorded score

controls.label: Previous clauses / More clauses
controls.purpose: Move between pages when the clauses do not all fit

rules: Ten clauses in fixed order; seven defective, three acceptable
Each defective clause has exactly one correct reason; a defective clause with the wrong reason counts as incorrect
Score = clauses judged correctly out of 10 on the first submission; mastery when score >= 9
assumptions: Application values are the chapter's illustrative dryer exhaust example
limitations: One correct reason per clause; real reviews may name several

sources: Twin City Fan Model RTF guide specification, Section 23 34 16, tcf.com Product Specifications in CSI format (clauses 3, 6, 7, 8)
Chapter 27 illustrative worked example (clauses 1, 5 and the application card)

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Apply review criteria to a realistic artifact and name the criterion for each defect
keyQuestions: Could a reviewer prove from the submittal that this requirement is met?
Which two clauses cannot both be true?
commonMisconceptions: A clause that sounds technical is complete
Spark-resistant Types A and B work at any temperature
The motor is sized for the hot operating point
An overall dBA value is the sound data a specification asks for
assessmentOpportunities: First-submission score shown as 'n of 10 clauses judged correctly'; mastery is 9 of 10 on the first submission.
